notes: «قرأت على مالك بن أنس والحارث بن مسكين ... عن ابن القاسم» is read literally: the two co-transmitters come before ابن القاسم. The sister sources split this into two routes (Malik direct; Harith through Ibn al-Qasim); the literal order is kept, so this reading is doubtful
«قراءة عليه وأنا أسمع» is a reading form, not a link
